final: SELECT AVG(step1_avg_bandwidth) as avg_of_avg_bandwidth, AVG(step1_record_count) as avg_of_record_count FROM (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) as step1_avg_bandwidth, COUNT(*) as step1_record_count FROM telescopes t JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY t.observstation, o.weathprofile)
